text:
maya: Heads up — onboarding run for vintage-mpt-13b failed during safetensors fetch after a credential rotation on the infra side. converter aborted with index mismatch.

sam: ugh. saw anything in the logs? 403 or partials?

maya: here's the tail of the convert log: ```
INFO convert: fetch manifest for revision 'main'
INFO convert: start shard download 1/6
WARN download: received HTTP 206 for shard-0003.safetensors (range)
ERROR convert: index.json checksum mismatch: expected 0x9f4b got 0x1a2c
ERROR convert: weight keymap validation failed: missing keys for layer_42
FATAL convert: aborting; partial shards left on disk
```

jonah: 206 + checksum mismatch = classic range request + CDN/credential race. If creds rotated mid-download S3 can return 206 with a different ETag/Content-Range.

anya: also noticed the config.json coming out of the converter lost `additional_special_tokens` mapping for the chat template preamble. our eval harness shows system prompts prepended as raw tokens now.

maya: right — evals showed a quantization regression but the root cause is the missing special tokens: prompts are tokenized incorrectly -> attention patterns broken -> quality drop.

sam: can we repro with full downloads (no ranged requests) and a pinned revision? try `HF_HUB_DISABLE_RANGES=1` and pin a revision sha in the importer.

maya: repro steps I ran locally: ```
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_RANGES=1
python -m rw_convert --model-id vintage-mpt-13b --revision=abc123 --out-dir /tmp/rwconv --force-download
```
that produced all shards and the converter completed, but the weight keys were still slightly renamed (old: `transformer.h.0.attn.q_proj.weight` -> new: `blocks.0.attn.q_w`). converter should have a mapping layer but it skipped it when index.json checksum failed.

jonah: so two bugs combined: 1) ranged download + credential rotation -> partial/206 + index checksum mismatch -> abort. 2) abort path doesn't cleanly surface that the key-rename step was skipped, leaving a half-cooked artifact.

convert-bot: uploaded artifact /artifacts/vintage-mpt-13b/1755550000/partial/ (6 files)

anya: temporary mitigation: re-run the convert with `--no-range` and `--enable-key-rename` and set `--pin-revision abc123`. For CI I added a check to fail early if index.json checksum != concatenated shard checksums.

sam: long-term we should: (a) detect 206/partial responses and retry full-range automatically, (b) make the rename/keymap stage transactional (write to tmp and only commit on success), and (c) add an end-to-end check that chat templates/special tokens survive conversion (simple tokenization roundtrip test).

maya: filing a bug with stack traces + the exact artifact list. tagging infra to confirm credential rotation window. @infra-bot can you confirm a key rotation around 2024-12-22T02:00Z?

infra-bot: confirmed: we rotated hub service principal at 2024-12-22T02:03Z UTC. Some long-lived range downloads may have been affected.

jonah: thanks — I'll draft a small PR to: 1) set default HF_HUB_DISABLE_RANGES=1 for convert jobs, 2) add transactional rename, 3) add a unit test for chat template token preservation.

maya: thanks team. I'm re-running the full-download conversion and will post eval diffs when done. :thumbsup:

sam: if you see different weight key names, drop the `--keymap` JSON into the thread, I'll add a quick patch to the loader to accept both variants.
